title: What could grow here?
intro: Start with a preset, or enter readings from your own field.
soilHint: Use readings from your latest soil test.
climateHint: Use seasonal averages, not today's forecast.
phHelp: pH measures acidity. Below 7 is acidic; above 7 is alkaline.
emptyBody: Add seven field readings to see the model's top three matches.
confidenceHelp: Confidence is the share of model tree votes. It is not the probability of a successful harvest.
lowBody: Please consult your district agriculture officer before choosing a crop.
stale: Readings changed. Run again to update your results.
readingHint: These inputs should reflect a field, not a target fertilizer dose.
